field.name: Link
field.summary: True when the Tool host lifetime should also be registered in the distributed application services.

field.name: Connect
field.summary: True when a shared instance should be registered in the distributed application services.

field.name: Console
field.summary: True when the ToolAspireHost should use console lifetime behavior.

field.name: builder
field.summary: The managed used for distributed application composition.

method.name: CreateApplicationConnection
method.summary: Create and register the shared connection when application connection is enabled.
method.param: The Tool host lifetime; no connection is created when it is absent.
method.returns: The registered connection, or null when connection is disabled or no Tool lifetime is available.
method.remarks: Registers the connection in the distributed application services.

method.name: LinkApplicationLifetime
method.summary: Register the Tool host lifetime in distributed application services when lifetime linking is enabled.
method.param: The Tool host lifetime to register.
method.remarks: Does nothing when linking is disabled or no Tool lifetime is available.

method.name: configuretoolaspirehost
method.summary: Execute Tool Aspire Host Configuration Actions.

method.name: configuretoolaspirehostasync
method.returns: A Task that represents the asynchronous operation.

method.name: ConfigureToolAspireHost_NoSync
method.summary: Add a tool Aspire host configuration action without acquiring the builder synchronization semaphore.
method.remarks: Registers a synchronous ToolAspireHost-configuration step in the shared ordered ToolAspireHost-configuration pipeline.

method.name: ConfigureToolAspireHostAsync_NoSync
method.summary: Add an async ToolAspireHost configuration action without acquiring the builder synchronization semaphore.
method.remarks: Registers an asynchronous ToolAspireHost-configuration step in the shared ordered ToolAspireHost-configuration pipeline.
